subject: general
question: On what sum will the simple interest at a rate of x% p.a. in x years will be ₹x?
solution:
Given:

Simple interest = ₹x

Rate of interest = x%

Time = x years

Concept used:

Simple Interest, SI = (P × R × T)/100

Amount = P + SI

where

P = Principal amou
